class.name: SentryAutoMetricsOptions
class.description: Configures performance metrics collected automatically by the SDK. Access these options through [member SentryOptions.auto_metrics] or Project Settings under [code]sentry/auto_metrics/frame_metrics[/code]. Automatic collection is disabled by default and does not affect metrics sent manually through [member SentrySDK.metrics]. [codeblock] SentrySDK.init(func(options: SentryOptions) -> void: options.auto_metrics.enable_frame_metrics = true options.auto_metrics.frame_metrics_interval_sec = 2.0 ) [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] Collection pauses while the application is unfocused or paused by the operating system. [member SceneTree.paused] and [member Engine.time_scale] do not affect collection. To learn more, visit [url=https://docs.sentry.io/platforms/godot/metrics/]Metrics documentation[/url].

members.member: If [code]true[/code], sends [code]game.perf.frame_time[/code] as a distribution in milliseconds and [code]game.perf.fps[/code] as a gauge. Frame time measures elapsed time between process callbacks, including VSync and frame limiting. The collector randomly samples one frame per [member frame_metrics_interval_sec] interval. As more clients send frame samples, aggregate percentiles become more reliable, though sampling can miss rare hitches.
Controls how often frame metrics are sent, in seconds. Ignored when [member enable_frame_metrics] is [code]false[/code].
